title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Word
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·情感与情绪）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·情感与情绪）　|　核心词汇：emotion　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 emotion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1942 my grandmother ① showed an emotion that no doctor in the house would have named, and she said the showing was the whole of the winter. The ② emotion, meaning the feeling and not the state, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an emotion, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ emotion in that house had the same short word at the end of it, and the ④ emotion at the end, meaning the one they kept for the child and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An emotion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandmother said the naming is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the emotion was the whole of the story, meaning the state and not the feeling. The ⑥ emotion, meaning the state and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody feels and nobody names; emotion, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both a feeling and a state. He said the state is the part they remember.

By 1951 the ⑦ emotion had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short word. The ⑧ emotion of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one house and fourteen winters of naming; emotion, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ emotion I remember is the one named in the letter, which faded in 1963 and is still described as the quietest in the house. An ⑩ emotion, my mother said in 1965, is the only one that improves by being named; every emotion, she said, is a state that has agreed to look like a feeling. She said the state was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 情感；情绪（指那座房子里流露过的那一种）
B. n. 情感；情绪（指那种情感本身，与情绪状态相对）
C. 固定搭配：show an emotion 流露一种情感
D. n. 情感；情绪（指留给孩子的那一种）
E. n. 情感；情绪（抽象总称，指一家人的情感之事）
F. n. 情感；情绪（指信里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 情绪状态；激动（指故事里人人都感到却无人命名的那样东西）
H. n. 情绪状态（抽象总称，指人人都感到却无人命名的那种状态）

items.q: showed an emotion that no doctor in the house would have named
The emotion, meaning the feeling and not the state
the emotion was the whole of the story
the emotion had become a line in a letter
The emotion of the whole thing
An emotion, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: show an emotion 意为“流露一种情感”，1942 年祖母流露了一种屋子里没有一位医生肯命名的情感。
emotion 意为“情感、情绪”，指那种情感本身而不是情绪状态，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
emotion 意为“情感、情绪”，指那座房子里的每一种情感，每一种到头都有同一句短短的话。
emotion 意为“情感、情绪”，指留给孩子的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
emotion 意为“情绪状态、激动”，指故事里人人都感到却无人命名的那样东西，叔叔说这种情绪状态就是那个故事的全部。
emotion 意为“情绪状态”，指人人都感到却无人命名的那种状态而不是那种情感，是故事里人人都感到、却无人命名的东西。
emotion 意为“情感、情绪”，指信里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1951 年这种情感成了信里的一行。
emotion 意为“情感、情绪”，祖母一月写道，整件事的情感之事是一座房子和十四个冬天的命名。
emotion 意为“情感、情绪”，我记得的是信里记下的那一种，1963 年淡去了，至今仍被说成屋子里最安静的一种。
emotion 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，一种情感是唯一会因为被好好命名而变得更好的东西。
